observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The male lead breaks down basic steps step-by-step from zero with a female partner accompanying him. He explains posture, foot placement, and torso movement clearly before practicing.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the Duranguense dance series.
Explanation of foot posture, weight distribution, and leg bend.
Adding knee and torso styling to the marching steps.
Full practice counting 1 to 8 facing front.
Practicing the step to music with front and back views.
Concluding remarks and channel call to action.

steps_taught.name: Paso básico Duranguense
steps_taught.description: Marching in place with knee and torso styling.

what_works: Step-by-step explanation starting from foot posture and body alignment
Demonstration from both front and back views
what_hinders: Lacks detailed weight transfer explanation for turning or traveling

quotes.text: Lo primero que vamos a hacer es que vamos a juntar nuestros pies.
